rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulaṃ

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching regarding the attainment of powers?
premises: The teaching concerns eight specific attainments.
The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: The root Kaula is defined as the attainment of the eight powers.
uncertainties: The specific eight powers are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula.
